en.title: Banner & Technical Handbook (THB)
en.excerpt: Uploading high-resolution hero banners, Technical Handbook (THB PDF) documents, and official sponsor logos.
en.content:
1. Hero Banner Dimensions & Guidelines

The tournament banner is the visual centerpiece of your championship landing page. To ensure sharp presentation across desktop and mobile devices:

  • Recommended Resolution: 1920 x 1080 pixels (16:9 aspect ratio).
  • File Formats: PNG, JPG, or high-compression WebP.
  • Maximum File Size: 5MB per upload.
  • Design Tip: Keep important event typography (championship title, date, venue) centered to avoid clipping on narrow smartphone screens.

2. Uploading Technical Handbook (THB)

The Technical Handbook (THB / Petunjuk Teknis) outlines official rules, protest mechanisms, timing regulations, and award ceremonies:

  1. Open your tournament in Organizer Dashboard > Media & Documents.
  2. In the Technical Handbook section, click Upload Document (PDF).
  3. Select your official THB PDF file (maximum 15MB).
  4. Once uploaded, a prominent Download Technical Handbook (PDF) button is automatically generated on your public event page.

3. Sponsor & Partner Logo Placement

Organizers can acknowledge institutional partners, government bodies (KONI/Perpani), and commercial sponsors:

  • Upload transparent PNG logos (recommended 400x200 pixels).
  • Categorize sponsors into Gold, Silver, or Community Partners.
  • Logos are displayed along the footer of the tournament landing page and rendered on printed Result Books.

4. Asset Optimization & File Limits

All uploaded media is cached and served via optimized content delivery networks (CDN) for fast loading even when hundreds of archers check in simultaneously during morning registration.

id.title: Banner & Buku Panduan Teknis (THB)
id.excerpt: Panduan mengunggah banner utama beresolusi tinggi, dokumen Petunjuk Teknis (THB PDF), serta logo sponsor resmi turnamen.
id.content:
1. Ukuran & Panduan Banner Utama

Banner turnamen adalah elemen visual utama pada halaman landing kejuaraan Anda. Untuk memastikan tampilan yang tajam di layar komputer maupun smartphone:

  • Rekomendasi Resolusi: 1920 x 1080 piksel (rasio 16:9).
  • Format File: PNG, JPG, atau WebP.
  • Batas Ukuran File: Maksimal 5MB per unggahan.
  • Tips Desain: Letakkan informasi penting (judul turnamen, tanggal, lokasi) di area tengah agar tidak terpotong pada layar smartphone yang ramping.

2. Mengunggah Petunjuk Teknis (THB PDF)

Buku Panduan Teknis (Technical Handbook / THB / Juklak-Juknis) memuat peraturan lomba, jadwal resmi, mekanisme protes, dan upacara penghormatan pemenang:

  1. Buka turnamen Anda di Dashboard Organizer > Media & Dokumen.
  2. Pada bagian Buku Panduan Teknis (THB), klik Unggah Dokumen (PDF).
  3. Pilih berkas PDF resmi Anda (maksimal 15MB).
  4. Setelah terunggah, tombol Unduh Buku Petunjuk Teknis (PDF) akan otomatis muncul di halaman publik turnamen.

3. Penempatan Logo Sponsor & Mitra

Panitia dapat menampilkan logo induk organisasi (KONI/Perpani), instansi pendukung, dan sponsor komersial:

  • Unggah logo berlatar transparan (format PNG transparan, rekomendasi 400x200 piksel).
  • Logo akan ditampilkan di bagian bawah (*footer*) halaman turnamen dan dicetak pada Buku Hasil Resmi (*Result Book*).

4. Optimasi Media & Batas Ukuran File

Seluruh berkas media disimpan dan disajikan melalui jaringan pengiriman konten cepat (CDN) untuk memastikan akses yang lancar saat diakses oleh ratusan pemanah secara bersamaan.
